bars.doubts: RH beats 2 and 4: the E-space note has no accidental of its own; read as Eb5 because the flat printed on beat 1 persists through the bar (D7b9: Eb5 against F#5, printed as a displaced 'second'). The single sharp before beat 2 is centred on the F5 line -> F#5, which also carries to beat 4.

Naturals on F5/F6 (RH beat 1), E6 (RH beat 4) and F4 (LH beat 3) are courtesy naturals cancelling bar 24's F#/Eb; pitches are plain F/E. Middle note of the half-note chord has no accidental -> Bb5. Three ties from the half-note chord to the beat-3 eighth chord (F6, Bb5, F5).

Flat before the first RH chord is centred on the D6 space -> Db6 (persists into beats 2.5 and 4). F6 in the RH sits against E3 in the LH arpeggio (printed). Four ties from the dotted-quarter chord to the beat-4 quarter chord.

8va bracket starts at bar 27 (pitches as printed; sounding an octave higher). Top note of the first RH chord sits ABOVE the A5 ledger line (ledger at the bottom of the notehead) -> Bb5, resolving to A5 (ledger through the notehead) in the second chord - an appoggiatura Bb->A like bar 23's G->F.
